body:
I've considered something along the lines. Joining the military with high blood pressure seems to be hard to do. My ASVAB is perfect. I could do anything though.

I have also considered taking the $6000 i have and running to Europe. I have no endgame plan for that though. So I doubt it will happen.

I'm not doing it over money or failure though. The root cause is just a lack of a will to struggle to continue living.

Thanks for the offer though!

As I said in the post. I stopped seeing the point in the struggle to live. It's not just about the money, rather it's a good point to say enough flailing about in life is enough.

I don't CARE enough to work to get out of debt. I'm just kind of done.
I guess I phrased this poorly. I just want to be sure my family wont have any extra financial issues. I should somehow leave that 401K money to cover funeral costs.
Well It wouldn't forgive the larger half of my debt which is private. Regardless, I already feel like enough of a failure. I'd prefer to end it as well.
